source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'San Jose Earthquakes and DUDE Wipes Announce Official Back-of-Jersey Partnership'
source.quote: The San Jose Earthquakes announced today a new multiyear back-of-jersey partnership with DUDE Wipes, the fast-growing personal care brand.

note: Back-of-jersey logo from the 1 August 2026 match (a new league-wide asset allowed after the 2026 All-Star break). End date and value not disclosed; Inside World Football (2026-08-03) notes 'No value was given for the sponsorship.'
